tei:div.tei:p: (nya)༄༅// gu ru drag dmar nyang lugs 'bring po me'i spu gri'i sgrub rjes man ngag dang bcas pa'i skor rnams bzhugs so// ༄༅// dpal ldan yon tan 'byung ba'i gtso// pad+ma rgyal la phyag 'tshal te// o rgyan drag por sgrub pa'i thabs// ma bu'i shog ser bsdebs te bri// bla ma dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su song nas/ sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob par bya/ de'i phyir o rgyan drag po bsgrub par bya snyam du sems bskyed de/ stong pa'i ngang las e las nam mkha' mthing nag 'byams yas pa'i dbus su yam̐ las rlung nag 'khrugs pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su ram̐ las me ri me phung gi klong yangs par ra las rak+ta'i rgya mtsho zhing gi rba klong 'phyo bar kam̐ las keng rus kyi sa gzhi dang ri rab brtsegs pa'i steng du/ bh+rūm̐ las thod pa 'bar ba'i gzhal yas khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi rta babs bzhi dang ldan pa/ rgya nam mkha'i khams kyi mtha' klas pa/ phyi nang kun tu ye shes kyi me ri dang me phung 'bar ba'i dbus su pam̐ las sna tshogs pad+ma/ ram̐ las nyi ma'i steng du dregs pa sde brgyad kha bub dang byi chings su bsnol ba'i steng du hūm̐ las rang nyid zil gnon pad+ma sku mdog dmar nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas gser gyi rdo rje rtse dgu hūm̐ dgu phaṭa dgu ram̐ dgus mtshan pa 'phyar thabs su 'dzin pa/ g.yon lcags kyi sdig pa kha dgu mig dgu pa phyir la gdangs pa bsnams pa/ zhabs g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang pa/ stag gi pags pas sham thabs byas pa/ mi mgo rlon pas do shal byas pa/ sbrul nag gis brgyan pa/ mi lpags kyi g.yang gzhi dang glang chen gyi ko rlon gyis stod g.yogs pa/ thod pa skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/ sbrul nag gi thod bcings can/ dbu skra dmar ser gyen la brdzes shing*/ rin po che dang rus pa'i snyan cha byas pa/ zhal mche ba gtsigs shing spyan gsum sdang mig tu gzigs pa/

smin ma dang sma ra dmar ser me ltar 'bar ba/ rdo rje 'bar ba'i spu gseb nas ye shes kyi me rab tu 'bar ba/ spyugs pa'i 'thor rlung phyogs bcur 'phro zhing*/ sku las bskal pa'i me chen 'bar ba'i dpral ba'i mdzod sbur gser gyi 'khor lo rtsibs bzhi pa'i lte bar 'jam dpal ser po g.yas ral gri klad la bskor zhing*/ g.yon sdigs mdzub thugs kar mdzad pa'i spyi bor oṃ ser pos mtshan pa/ mgrin par pad+ma 'dab bzhi'i dbus su rta mgrin dmar po dbyug to 'phyar thabs su 'dzin pa/ g.yon sdig mdzub thugs kar mdzad pa'i mgrin par pad+ma 'dab bzhi'i dbus su āḥdamar pos mtshan pa/ snying gar nyi ma'i dbus gser gyi mchod rten bang rim bzhi pa'i bum pa'i nang gi nyi ma'i dbus su phyag na rdo rje mthing ga g.yas rdo rje 'phyar thabs su nam mkhar 'dzin cing*/ g.yon sdigs mdzub thugs kar mdzad pa'i thugs dbus pad+ma dang nyi ma'i dbus su hūm̐ la rtsa ba'i sngags kyis mar me 'bar ba ltar bskor ba'o// thor tshugs kyi rtse la khro las bya khyung ga ru ḍa gshog pa gdengs pas nam mkha' chong pa/ rdo rje 'bar ba'i spu gseb nas ye shes kyi me dang gnam lcags kyi thog 'phro ba/ rwa rin po che'i dbal kha la 'od dpag med dmar po mnyam gzhag can/ na bza' chos gos dmar ser gsol ba/ steng gi nam mkha' la pad+ma dang nyi ma'i dbus su thod phreng rtsal mthing ga rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum ye shes mtsho rgyal dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ bla ma dang yi dam mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyis bskor bar bsam mo// de nas snying ga'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas 'og min nas sngar bsgoms pa lta bu'i bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro'i dkyil 'khor skad cig gis steng gi nam mkhar byon pa la/ oṃ gu ru de wa ḍā ki nī puṣ+pe/ dhū pe/ ā lo ke/ gan+dhe/ nai wi d+yā/ shab+da āḥhūm̐/ lan gsum gyis sku gsung thugs mnyes pa'i mchod pa phul nas/

dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes brjod pas lha ye shes sems dpa' de dag bdag dam tshig sems dpa'i lha la thim pas dgyes shing brtan par gyur/ yang de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad 'dus nas rin po che'i bum pas dbang bskur bas sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las ye shes rdo rje'i dngos grub thob/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams gcig tu gyur pa 'od dpag med la thim par gyur/ gsal bar gyur/ 'od 'bar bar gyur to// de nas thod mkhar 'bar ba'i phyi nam mkha'i khams kyi mtha' klas pa'i steng 'og phyogs mtshams thams cad rdo rje'i gur khyim du gyur pa'i phyi rol gser gyi 'khor lo rtsibs stong g.yas su 'khor ba dang*/ mtshon cha'i 'khor lo rtsibs stong g.yon du 'khor ba'i steng 'og me'i 'khor lo rtsibs stong rtse bsnol du 'khor ba'i bar rnams su dregs pa sde brgyad thams cad mgo lus dum bur gtubs shing*/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ las hūm̐ 'phros ba spu'i bu ga nas hūm̐ rnams phyir thon pas sprul pa'i khro chung du gyur/ phyir 'phros nam mkha' gang*/ rig sngags kyi 'brug sgra stong bsgrags pas dregs pa sde brgyad thams cad tshar bcad/ 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad g.yo ldeg mer 'khyom par bsam zhing*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gu ru de wa ḍā ki nī artsika nirtsika na mo bha ga wa te hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ aḥyaḥmaḥduḥruḥtsaḥshaḥnaḥ oṃ badz+ra hūm̐/ yak+ṣa hūm̐/ rak+ṣa hūm̐/ gu ru ḍā tsa le hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa/ ces ci 'grub tu sems gzhan du ma yengs par rig pa ngar dang ldan pas bzla'o// de nas thun 'jog khar sprul pa'i khro chung rnams hūm̐ la bsdu/ 'khor lo rang mal du gnas pa'i ngang la sems ma bcos par klod nas stong gsal spros pa med par dar cig mnyam par gzhag rjes sems can gyi don du bsngo/ phan yon ni bgegs dang bar chad thams cad zhi ba dang*/ sgom nyams ting nge 'dzin thams cad gong nas gong du 'phel ba dang*/

mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub myur du thob pa la sogs pa gzhung nas bshad pa ltar 'grub bo// grangs kyi bsnyen pa ni 'bum phrag nyi shu rtsa gnyis su gsungs so// bsnyen pa rdzogs nas las tshogs kyang 'grub bo// gtor ma dang*/ 'khor lo dang*/ byab chog dang*/ ser srung dang*/ sde brgyad gnad la dbab ba la sogs pa ma yig dang*/ bu yig dang*/ las phran tshegs kyi shog ser gzhung nas bshad pa bzhin du shes par bya'o// 'di ni sgom rim lag len du bkod pa ma yig bu yig bstod pa gsum 'khrugs bsdebs te nyams su blang ba'i phyir bkod pa'o// dge ba 'di yis bdag dang 'gro ba kun// rang byung pad+ma rgyal po'i gnas thob nas// mchog dang thun mong dngos grub char 'bebs shing*// skye rgu'i re ba yid bzhin 'grub par shog /drag sgrub gsal ba'i me long brag srin mo sbar rjes can gyi gter gyi yang snying rgyal sras dri med 'od zer gyis bkod pa rdzogs so// ༈ /gu ru drag dmar gyi bla ma brgyud pa la gsol ba 'debs pa 'dod don kun stsol zhes bya ba bzhugs so// oṃ swa sti/ snang ba mtha' yas 'phags mchog thugs rje'i gter// pad+ma 'byung gnas rnam 'phrul mnga' bdag nyang*// mnga' bdag sras chung gu ru chos rin chen// chos nyid rang grol rnams la gsol ba 'debs// sangs rgyas lhun dbang kun dga' bkra shis pa// rgyal sras chos rje sngags 'chang legs pa dpal// shes rab rgyal mtshan sa lo thams cad mkhyen// kun dga' rin chen rnams la gsol ba 'debs// bsod nams dbang po nam mkha' sangs rgyas dang*// nam mkha' dpal bzang sangs rgyas phun tshogs rje// bstan 'dzin lhun grub nam

'di man zhal skong*/ mkha' bsam 'grub zhabs// kun dga' blo gros rnams la gsol ba 'debs// dpal ldan chos skyong bstan pa'i nyi ma che// kun dga' bkra shis brgyud srol kun 'dus pa// ngag gi dbang po kun dga' rin chen dang*// rtsa ba'i bla ma rnams la gsol ba 'debs// dngos brgyud bla ma'i tshogs dang dbyer med pa'i// pad+ma thod phreng rtsal gyi lha tshogs kyi// mkhyen brtse nus pa bsam gyis mi khyab pas// byang chub bar du bsrung zhing bskyang du gsol// gnas skabs sa 'og sa steng sa bla yi// lha srin sde brgyad mi dang mi min gyis// sdang dang gdug pa'i bsam sbyor kun spangs nas// byams pa'i sems kyis bsrung bar byin gyis rlobs// tshe rabs bsags pa'i sdig ltung kun sbyangs nas// sgo gsum pad+ma thod phreng drag po yi// sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rjer legs bsgrubs nas// bstan 'gror phan bde 'byung bar byin gyis rlobs// snyigs ma'i rang stobs bdo ba'i gnas skabs 'dir// dam chos sgrub pa'i 'gal rkyen rgud pa rnams// nyi 'od dang 'phrad mun pa ltar zhi nas// mthun rkyen dbyar mtsho lta bur 'phel bar mdzod// ces gu ru drag po nyang lugs kyi dbang gi bla ma brgyud pa'i gsol ba 'debs pa 'dod don kun stsol zhes bya ba 'di ni dge slong bstan 'dzin rnam rgyal gyi ngor ban+de tshul khrims rin chen gyis bris pa'o// maṅga laṃ// ༈ /gu ru drag dmar me'i phreng ba can gyi sgrub thabs dang rjes gnang gi cho ga rnam gsal me long zhes bya ba bzhugs/ chos sku spros bral dbyings las ma g.yos kyang*// gzugs sku khro chen 'bar bas 'jig rten gyi// dregs pa 'dul mdzad thod phreng rtsal btud de// nyang lugs drag po pad+ma'i rjes gnang bri// de'ang mnga' bdag nyang nas brgyud pa'i gu ru drag dmar gyi rjes gnang byed par/ sbyor ba dngos gzhi rjes gsum gyi dang po la/

maṇ+ḍal gyi khar rdul tshon gyis zla gam gcig par bris pa 'di/ snga ma'i yig cha rnams su byung ba/ 'og tu bskyed du med kyang lha 'di dbang gi drag po yin pa'i mtshon byed tsam byas pa yin nam snyam/ de ltar yin na lha bskyed skabs zla gam tshom bu bcas lha skur bskyed dgos pa 'dra'o// zla gam dmar po sgo gcig pa bris pa'i dbus su tshon phung dmar po dgod pa'am/ yang na tshom bu bkod pas kyang btub ste/ de'i steng mañdzi'i khar dpal gtor rin chen 'bar ba sku gzugs kyis brgyan pa/ de'i g.yas su gsung gi dbang rdzas thod pa mtshan ldan du chang la bdud rtsi ril bu btab pa dang*/ g.yon du 'bru'i khar thugs kyi dbang rdzas gnam lcags kyi rdo rje bzhag pa dang*/ sman phud rak+ta dang nyer spyod bcas pa bsham mo// thog mar yo byad rnams byin gyis brlab pa ni/ rang gi snying ga nas ram̐ yam̐ kham̐ gyi yi ge gsum 'phros pas mchod rdzas rnams kyi nyes skyon thams cad bsregs gtor bkrus te sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las a las ye shes kyi ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhu ba las byung ba'i nye bar spyod pa rnams dang*/ sman rag gtor ma rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med pa 'dod pa'i yon tan gyi phung po bsam gyis mi khyab par gyur par bsams la/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra pā d+yaṃ āḥhūm̐/ badz+ra puṣ+pe sogs nas/ shab+da āḥhūm̐ zhes so so'i phyag rgya bcas dang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥzhes lan gsum brjod pas byin gyis brlab bo// sgrub thabs kyi sngon 'gro la/ bla ma yi dam la sogs pa'i skyabs gnas thams cad mdun gyi nam mkhar bzhugs pa la bdag dang sems can thams cad rtse gcig tu skyabs su 'gro bar bsams la/ na mo/ bla ma bde gshegs 'dus pa'i sku// dkon mchog gsum gyi rang bzhin la// bdag dang 'gro drug sems can rnams// byang chub bar du skyabs su mchi// na mo/

thugs rjes 'gro la dgongs mdzad pa'i// bla ma rnams la skyabs su mchi// rtse gcig thugs rjes byin rlob pa'i// yi dam lha la skyabs su mchi// rtsol rtog med pa'i thugs rje can// sangs rgyas rnams la skyabs su mchi// chags pa med pa'i 'gro don can// dam pa'i chos la skyabs su mchi// ma nor lam la mnga' mdzad pa'i// dge 'dun rnams la skyabs su mchi// 'gro ba'i don du rang byung sku 'khrungs pa'i// pad+ma 'byung gnas sku la skyabs su mchi// nyes legs stangs 'dzin dam tshig rjes skyong ba'i// phyi nang mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la skyabs su mchi// na mo/ brgyud pa'i rtsa ba bla ma rje// dngos grub 'byung ba'i yi dam lha// legs par byin rlob mkha' 'gro ste// rtsa ba gsum la skyabs su mchi// rtsa ba gsum gyi byin gyis rlobs// zhes pa'i skyabs 'gro lan gsum/ bsdu na tshigs bcad dang po de lan gsum brjod/ sems bskyed ni/ na mo/ sems bskyed 'gro ba kun don du// bla ma sangs rgyas bsgrubs nas ni// gang la gang 'dul phrin las kyis/ 'gro drug bsgral bar dam bca' 'o// zhes lan gsum/ rang skad cig gis gu ru drag po'i skur gyur pa'i thugs kar hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas/ bla ma yi dam dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dang bcas pa thams cad mdun gyi nam mkhar oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes pas spyan drangs pa'i spyan sngar yan lag bdun pa bgyi'o snyam pas ngag tu/ bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro dgongs// nyi zla pad+ma'i gdan la bzhugs// lus ngag yid gsum gus phyag 'tshal// phyi nang gsang gsum mchod pa 'bul// nyams chag sdig sgrib mthol zhing bshags// gsang sngags sgrub la rjes yi rang*// smin grol gsang sngags 'khor lo bskor// mya ngan mi 'da' bzhugs su gsol// snying po sems can don du bsngo// yang dag rdo rje'i don rtogs shog /ces pa lan gsum brjod/ dngos gzhi lha bskyed pa la/

bdag dang mdun bskyed kyi rten rnams la dmigs te/ oṃ swa bhā wa sogs brjod pas stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las chos 'byung gru gsum mthing ga yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du/ bh+rūm̐ las thod mkhar gyi gzhal yas khang phyi nang thams cad me klung dmar nag 'bar ba/ de'i nang du pad+ma nyi ma zhing chen bsnol ba'i gdan gyi steng du hūm̐ yig dmar po/ de las 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros pas sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs rgyud bskul/ sems can thams cad kyi don byas/ tshur 'dus hūm̐ la thim pa las/ bdag mdun tha mi dad du gu ru drag po sku mdog dmar po me'i phreng bas brgyan pa/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa spyan gsum bgrad pa/ phyag g.yas pas gnam lcags kyi rdo rje rtse dgu pa nam mkha' la 'phyar ba/ g.yon pas lcags kyi sdig pa mgo dgu pa bsnams pa/ dbu skra snum 'bol gyen la brdzes pa/ thod pa skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/ rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ sku la rus pa'i rgyan drug dang sbrul gyis brgyan pa/ sku stod la glang lpags dang zhing chen gyi g.yang gzhi'i na bza' gsol ba/ sku smad la stag gi pags pa'i 'og pag can/ khrag gi thig le dang*/ zhag gi zo ris dang*/ thal chen gyi tshom bus brgyan pa/ zhabs 'dor stabs kyis me phung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ de'i spyi gtsug na bya khyung mthing nag me'i gshog pa can/ gnam lcags kyi thog dang me'i tshwa tshwa 'phro ba/ de'i steng du rigs bdag snang ba mtha' yas sku mdog dmar po phyag gnyis mnyam gzhag mdzad pa/ dpral ba'i mdzod spur 'jam pa'i sku mdog ser po g.yas ral gri bsnams pa/ mgrin par rta mgrin dmar po g.yas rdo rje'i dbyug pa 'phyar ba/ thugs kar phyag na rdo rje mthing nag g.yas rdo rje 'phyar ba/ g.yon pa thams cad thugs kar sdigs mdzub mdzad pa/ gsang bar khro bo yak+ṣa me dbal sku mdog dmar nag g.yas rdo rje/ g.yon tho ba bsnams pa/

de ltar gsal ba'i spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ ye ge gsum las 'od zer 'phros pas sku gsung thugs kyi lha tshogs rnams dang phyogs bcu'i rigs lnga'i sangs rgyas thams cad spyan drangs/ bdag mdun tha mi dad kyi lha la thim pas ye shes pa 'dres pa dang dbang bskur pa lhan cig tu gyur par bsam/ mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ oṃ gu ru de wa ḍā ki nī sa pa ri wā ra oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra pā d+yaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐/ de bzhin du/ dhū pe/ ā lo ke/ ghan+dhe/ nai wi d+yā/ shab+da āḥhūm̐ zhes phyag rgya dang bcas pas mchod/ yang sngags de nyid la/ ma hā pañtsa a mṛ ta rak+ta pi pa tha āḥhūm̐ zhes btags pas sman dang rak+ta dbul/ gu ru de wa ḍā ki nī oṃ āḥhūm̐ artsika nirtsika sogs kyi mthar/ i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi btags pa lan gsum gyis gtor ma phul nas/ che mchog pad+ma thod phreng rtsal/ sku 'jam dpal/ gsung rta mgrin/ thugs phyag rdor/ khro bo yak+ṣa me dbal/ dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyis mchod pa dam pa 'di bzhes la/ bdag cag byang chub ma thob kyi bar du zhi rgyas dbang drag mngon spyod kyi las 'grub par mdzad du gsol/ zhes 'dod don gsol/ bstod pa ni/ hūm̐/ rang byung pad+ma thod phreng drag po'i sku// dregs pa lha srin sde brgyad 'dul mdzad cing*// 'khor ba ma lus 'dren pa'i dpal gyur pa'i// gu ru drag po'i lha tshogs phyag 'tshal bstod// nad gdon bar chad mtha' dag zhi ba dang*// mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsal du gsol// zhes brjod do// bzlas pa ni/ bdag mdun tha mi dad kyi thugs ka'i phyag rdor gyi snying gar nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ gi mthar sngags kyis bskor ba las 'od zer 'phros/ nad gdon sdig sgrib thams cad zhi bar byas/ gu ru'i byin rlabs thams cad bsdus nas rang la zhugs par bsams la/

oṃ āḥhūm̐ artsika nirtsika na mo bha ga wa te hūm̐ hūm̐ āḥhūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa ci nus bzlas mthar/ bcom ldan 'das bdag dang sems can thams cad la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub thams cad stsal du gsol zhes brjod la/ mdun bskyed kyi thugs ka nas bdag nyid lhar gsal ba bya ste rang gnas su 'khod par bsam/ de nas slob ma khrus byas phyag phul nas gral la 'khod pa la/ 'o nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad ces pa nas/ gu ru drag po'i rjes su gnang ba zhu snyam pa'i sems bskyed gsal gdab/ de la 'dir gsan par bya ba'i rjes su gnang ba ni/ o rgyan gyi slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas nyid srog bdag rgyal 'gong la sogs pa'i 'jig rten gyi dregs pa can rnams 'dul ba'i gnyen por che mchog gu ru drag po'i skur bzhengs te/ lha srin sde brgyad spyi dang*/ bye brag tu srog bdag rgyal 'gong pe kar la sogs pa'i gdug pa can thams cad btul te/ de dag gi srog snying bzhes te dam la btags nas phyi rabs ma 'ongs snyigs ma'i dus su sems can thams cad la phan 'dogs che bar rjes su dgongs nas/ gter kha mang por gu ru drag dmar gyi chos skor 'jog par mdzad pa las/ da lan 'dir slob dpon chen po nyid kyi sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i rol pa mnga' bdag nyang ral pa can gyis lho brag srin mo sbar rjes nas spyan drangs pa'i chos skor zab rgyas/ de ltar rje btsun sa skya pa rnams la bka' srol ma nub par bzhugs pa las/ slob ma gzhug pa'i rim pa la'ang byin rlabs dbang gi rim pa dang*/ rjes su gnang ba gnyis yod pa las 'dir rjes su gnang ba yin/ de la sngon 'gro slob dpon gyi bya ba rnams grub zin nas slob ma la bya ba ni/ slob dpon gu ru drag por gsal ba la rjes su gnang ba zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal 'bul bar zhu/ zhes maṇ+ḍal dang*/ gsol ba 'debs pa ni/ dus gsum sangs rgyas 'dus pa'i sku// bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa yis// bdag ni 'khor ba'i duḥkha las// bsgral phyir byin gyis brlab tu gsol// zhes lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab nas/

skyabs su 'gro ba ni/ mdun gyi nam mkhar bla ma yi dam skyabs gnas dkon mchog gsum dang*/ khyad par sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo slob dpon chen po pad+ma drag po la dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyis bskor ba mngon sum lta bur bzhugs par dmigs pa la/ bdag dang sems can thams cad rtse gcig tu skyabs su 'gro bar bsams la 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ na mo/ bla ma bde gshegs 'dus pa'i sku zhes pa nas/ rtsa ba gsum gyi byin gyis rlobs// zhes pa'i bar lan gsum brjod/ bsdu na tshigs bcad dang po de ka lan gsum gyis chog de nas sems can gyi don du rang nyid sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de thob nas gang la gang 'dul gyi sgo nas sems can thams cad 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho las bsgral bar bgyi'o snyam pas/ na mo/ sems bskyed sogs lan gsum/ slar yang yul de dag gi spyan sngar phyag 'tshal ba dang*/ mchod pa 'bul ba dang*/ sdig pa bshags pa dang*/ gsang sngags kyi lam sgrub par rjes su yi rang ba dang*/ smin grol sngags kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bskul ba dang*/ mya ngan las mi 'da' bar gsol ba 'debs pa dang*/ dge ba byang chub tu bsngo ba ste thun mong ma yin pa'i yan lag bdun pa bgyi snyam pas/ bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro dgongs zhes pa nas/ yang dag rdo rje'i don rtogs shog ces pa'i bar lan gsum/ de nas bdag mdun gnyis ka'i thugs ka nas 'od zer dmar po 'phros/ khyed rnams kyi lus la phog pas tshe thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib sogs gzhi lus sbyangs nas/ stong pa'i ngang las chos kyi 'byung gnas sogs nas slob ma gu ru drag dmar du gong ltar bskyed la/ gnas gsum du 'bru gsum gsal gdab/ bdag mdun gnyis ka'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ o rgyan mkha' 'gro'i pho brang dpal ri pad+ma 'od kyi gzhal yas nas gu ru drag po thod phreng rtsal gyi lha tshogs la dpa' bo dang mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyis bskor ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa spyan drangs/

khyed rnams gu ru drag por gsal ba'i sku lus la sib sib thim pas nad gdon sdig sgrib dang bar du gcod pa thams cad tshar bcad cing zhi bar byas par mos pa mdzod/ dril gsil rol chen bya zhing rtsa sngags brjod/ de nas gtor ma gu ru drag por gsal ba'i spyi bor bzhag la/ oṃ/ bla ma rnams kyi byin rlabs dang*// yi dam lha yi ting 'dzin gyis// mkha' 'gro dbang du bsdu ba'i phyir// dam rdzas gtor ma'i dbang bskur bas// sku yi byin rlabs lus la zhugs// lus kyi sgrib pa byang gyur nas// sku mi 'gyur rdo rje'i dngos grub stsol// gu ru de wa ḍā ki nī oṃ āḥhūm̐ artsika nirtsika na mo bha ga wa te hūm̐ hūm̐ āḥhūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa/ kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ/ khyed rnams kyi spyi bo nas pad+ma thod phreng rtsal gyi sku'i rang bzhin 'od zer dkar po'i rnam pas thim zhing dbang bskur bas mgrin pa yan chad pad+ma thod phreng rtsal gyi skur dmar lam gyis gyur snyam pa ni sku'i byin gyis brlab pa ste/ gtor ma nas cung zad bcad nas sbyin/ mdun bskyed kyi gsung gi rang bzhin bdud rtsi'i thod pa mgrin par bzhag la/ āḥ bla ma rnams kyi byin rlabs dang*// yi dam lha yi ting 'dzin gyis// mkha' 'gro dbang du bsdu ba'i phyir// dam rdzas bdud rtsi'i dbang bskur bas// gsung gi byin rlabs ngag la zhugs// ngag gi sgrib pa byang gyur nas// gsung snying po sngags kyi dngos grub stsol// gu ru de wā ḍā ki nī oṃ āḥhūm̐ artsika nirtsika na mo bha ga wa te hūm̐ hūm̐ āḥhūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa/ wāka a bhi ṣiñtsa āḥ zhes dang bdud rtsi byin pas khyed rang gi mgrin pa nas pad+ma thod phreng rtsal gyi gsung gi rang bzhin bdud rtsi dmar po'i rnam pas thim zhing dbang bskur bas lte ba yan chad pad+ma thod phreng rtsal gyi skur dmar lam gyis gyur snyam pa ni gsung gi byin gyis brlab pa'o// mdun bskyed kyi thugs kyi rang bzhin lcags kyi rdo rje snying gar bzhag la/

hūm̐/ bla ma rnams kyi byin rlabs dang*// yi dam lha yi ting 'dzin gyis// mkha' 'gro dbang du bsdu ba'i phyir// dam tshig rdo rje'i dbang bskur bas// thugs kyi byin rlabs sems la zhugs// yid kyi sgrib pa byang gyur nas// thugs skye med rdo rje'i dngos grub stsol// gu ru de wa ḍā ki nī oṃ āḥhūm̐ artsika nirtsika na mo bha ga wa te hūm̐ hūm̐ āḥhūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa/ drag po thod phreng rtsal badz+ra sa ma ya tsit+ta a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes dang*/ khyed rang gi snying ga nas pad+ma thod phreng rtsal gyi thugs kyi rang bzhin rdo rje sngon po'i rnam pas thim zhing dbang bskur bas lte ba man chad pad+ma thod phreng rtsal gyi skur dmar lam gyis gyur snyam pa ni thugs kyi byin rlabs te rdzas la brten pa'i byin rlabs so// slar yang bla ma'i thugs ka nas sngags kyi 'od zer 'phros/ zhal nas drag po'i sngags tshar gcig brjod pas 'od zer gyis khyed rnams la phog pas lha'i sku rgyan gyi lha cha byad thams cad rdzogs par bkra lam gyis gsal thob cig de ni sku'i dbang dang*/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i sngags phreng las sngags phreng gnyis pa byung*/ khyed rnams kyi zhal du zhugs/ thugs ka'i sa bon gyi mthar 'khod par mos la/ sngags kyi rjes zlos lan gsum bya/ slob mas bcom ldan bdag la sogs dang*/ slob dpon gyis bcom ldan 'di la sogs brjod/ de ni gsung gi dbang dang*/ khyed rnams lha sku zhal phyag gi rnam pa snang la rang bzhin med pa la yid gtad pas/ gsal snang 'od gsal gyi ngang du bsdus te mi dmigs par sems gnas lugs kyi ngang du cung zad cig 'jog pa ni thugs kyi dbang ste/ de ltar dbang de thob nas dam tshig dang sdom pa 'dzin snyam pas/ gtso bos ji ltar sogs dang*/ gtang rag tu maṇ+ḍal phul/ de dag gis mnga' bdag nyang ral chen po'i lugs kyi gu ru drag po dmar po me'i phreng ba can gyi rjes su gnang ba thob pa yin pas rang gzhan gyi don rgya chen po mdzod/

bsod nams 'di yis sogs brjod la slob ma rang gnas su gtang ngo*// de nas slob dpon gyis mdun bskyed la mchod bstod sngar bzhin bya/ yig brgya lan gsum gyi mthar nongs pa bzod par gsol ba dang*/ mdun bskyed kyi ye shes pa skye med kyi klong du gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang la thim/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /pad+ma dbang drag 'grub gyur sogs kyis dge ba gzhan don du bsngo ba dang smon lam bkra shis rnams brjod do// smras pa/ snang srid dregs pa zil mnan rang dbang du// sdud byed drag po pad+ma'i sgrub thabs dang*// rjes gnang cho ga rnam gsal me long 'di// ldan phrug pad+ma thod phreng rtsal gyis bskrun// dge bas 'gro sems rdzing bu 'khrul snang gi// lha 'drer kun rtog glang pos rnyog pa'i rdul// dmigs med snying rje'i ke ta kas bgrungs par// cir snang dge ba'i zla snang ston gyur cig /ces gu ru drag dmar me'i phreng ba can gyi sgrub thabs dang rjes gnang gi cho ga rnam gsal me long zhes bya ba 'di ni/ gong mas byas pa'i yi ge ha cang bsdus ches pas mi gsal bar gyur pa/ lag tu blang bde ba zhig dgos zhes don gnyer 'gas bskul ngor/ nyang chen gzhung la sogs pa yig rnying sgrub thabs che 'bring dang*/ byin rlabs dbang chog rgyas bsdus rnams kyi bzhed pa dang mthun par baṇ+ḍe tshul khrims rin chen du bod pas lhun grub steng gi rgyal khab kyi ba gam gsum par bris pa sarba maṅga laṃ bha ba tu// ༈ /nyang gter gu ru drag po 'bring po me'i spu gri'i bsnyen thabs dregs pa kun 'joms zhes bya ba bzhugs so// gu ru badz+ra kro dhā ya na mā mi/ byin zab me char 'phro ba yis// dam sri ming tsam sreg byed pa'i// bla ma drag por gus btud nas// de yi bsnyen pa'i lag len spel// bla ma mnga' bdag chen pos lho brag srin mo sbar rjes nas spyan drangs pa'i gu ru drag po me'i spu gri'i bsnyen pa bya bar 'dod pas/

'di'i dbang gis rgyud smin cing dam tshig la legs par gnas pa'i sgrub pa pos gnas khang byi dor byas pa'i drung du bla ma zhi drag sogs sku gsung thugs kyi dam tshig gi rten bkram pa'i mdun du stegs bu la sman rag gtor gsum/ chu gnyis nyer spyod phreng tshar du bsham/ yi dam chos srung spyi dang*/ ma mgon sde brgyad kyi gtor ma bkod/ sngon gtor sogs nye bar mkho ba'i yo byad rnams tshogs par bya/ yar mar gyi tshes bcu'i dgongs thun nas/ phyi nang gi mtshams bcad la tho bzhag zhag bdun tsam skyabs 'gro brgya rtsa sogs gang mang byed/ de nas thun gyi thog mar tshig bdun sogs gsol 'debs sngon du 'gro bas/ thog mar dkar gtor gtong ba ni/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gsum/ rin po che'i snod du gtor ma ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ rang gi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros te dpal mgon bdun cu rtsa gnyis la sogs pa phyi rim skyong ba'i srung ma 'jig rten gyi chos skyong thams cad spyan drang*/ oṃ a kā ro sogs gsum gyis bsngos pas mnyes te bdag gi phrin las sgrub par bsams la/ hūm̐/ sngon gyi bskal pa'i dang po la: slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas kyi: bka' dang dam la btags pa yi: 'jig rten chos skyong dam tshig can: tshangs pa dang ni brgya byin dang : rgyal chen bzhi dang phyogs skyong bcu: lha chen brgyad dang klu chen brgyad: gza' chen brgyad dang gnod sbyin brgyad: rgyu skar nyi shu rtsa brgyad dang : bod khams skyong ba'i brtan ma dang : ma mo 'byung po sha za'i tshogs: srin po yi dwags smyo byed dang : yul phyogs 'di na gnas pa yi: gzhi bdag tshogs rnams thams cad dang : lha srin sde brgyad 'khor dang bcas: 'dir gshegs bdag la dgongs su gsol: mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la: sngon gyi dam las ma 'da' bar: rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la: nad sogs mi mthun zhi ba dang :

longs spyod rgya chen kun thob cing : log lta dbang du bsdu ba dang : mngon spyod mi mthun 'joms pa dang : las kyi dngos grub bdag la stsol: dam tshig can gyis bdag la srungs: dngos grub kun gyi sdong grogs mdzod: mthu rtsal can gyi bdag la srungs: bcol pa'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: ces bsngo/ de nas bgegs gtor gtong ba ni/ gong ltar byin brlab/ rang nyid skad cig gis dbang drag pad+ma khro gtum bzod par dka' ba'i gzi brjid can bskal pa'i me ltar 'bar ba'i skur gyur/ lcags kyu'i phyag rgya bcas la/ hūm̐: bla ma rnams kyi byin rlabs dang : yi dam lha yi ting 'dzin dang : mkha' 'gro rnams kyi mthu rtsal gyis: bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa la: gnod byed thams cad 'dir khug cig /badz+ra aṃ ku sha dzaḥ zhes bkug a kā ro lan gsum gyis bsngos la/ hūm̐: bka' gsang rmad byung dkyil 'khor 'dir: gsang ba'i dam can so so dang : 'dus pa'i lha rnams ma gtogs pa'i: bgegs dang log 'dren 'byung po'i tshogs: 'di ru ma 'dug gzhan du song: ci ste mi 'gro 'dug gyur na: thod phreng drag po khros nas ni: khyod kyi lus ngag yid gsum rnams: rdul phran bzhin du brlag par 'gyur: de bas rang rang gnas su dengs: sarba bigh+nān gats+tsha: yungs thun bcas bgegs bskrad: mtshams bcad pa ni: nga ni ye nas ngang gis khro: mtshams gcod khro bos nam mkha' gang: bgegs 'dul khro bo'i rol mtshams las: su yang 'da' bar ma byed cig: hūm̐: bla ma rnams kyi byin rlabs dang : yi dam lha yi ting 'dzin dang : mkha' 'gro rnams kyi mthu rtsal gyis: dngos grub bar chad byed pa'i bgegs: log par 'dren pa bdud kyi tshogs: 'di ru ma 'dug gzhan du dengs: oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrī: gu ru de ba ḍā ki nī badz+ra kro dha rak+ṣa hūm̐ phaṭa: oṃ artsika sogs brjod gu gul gyis bdug de nas bsam gtan gyi spyod lam dang ldan pas/ nyams len dngos la/

bla ma yi dam la sogs pa'i skyabs gnas thams cad mdun gyi nam mkhar bzhugs pa la bdag dang sems can thams cad rtse gcig tu skyabs su 'gro bar bsams la/ na mo/ bla ma bde gshegs 'dus pa'i sku// sogs nas/ 'gro drug bsgrol bar dam bca'o// bar lan gsum mam lnga la sogs pas skyabs sems blo dang 'dres nges su bya/ de nas rang skad cig gis gu ru drag po'i skur gyur pa'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas/ bla ma yi dam dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dang bcas pa thams cad mdun gyi nam mkhar oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥsogs nas/ yang dag rdo rje'i don rtogs shog /bar gyis yan lag bdun pa sgrub thabs ltar bya/ mdun gyi lha rnams bdag gi spyi bor byon nas 'od du zhu/ oṃ swa bhā wa sogs nas/ bstod pa'i bar gong sgrub thabs bzhin/ bzlas pa'i rim pa ni/ gong rtsa ba'i sgrub thabs kyi phyag rdor bskyed chog ltar/ bdag gi thugs rin po che gser gyi pu ri ri rab bang rim bum pa bre dang 'khor lo tog dang ldan pa'i bum par badz+ra pā ṇi/ de'i thugs kar nyi zla'i steng du hūm̐ dmar po'i mtha' mar sngags kyi phreng ba phreng thag la 'khor ba ltar bsams la/ de'ang mgal me klad la bskor ba lta bu dmar sga ra ra 'khor bar bsam/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ artsika nirtsika na mo bha ga wa te hūm̐ hūm̐ āḥhūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa/ ces bsnyen sngags 'bru nyi shu pa gtso bor bzla/ bzlas pa'i skabs/ thog mar lha sku'i gsal snang dang nga rgyal brtan pa/ dag dran rgyas pa'am/ snying po gsal rig stong pa zung 'jug gi ngang du gnas pa rnams gzhir byas nas/ thugs srog la sngags phreng g.yon skor du bkod de gsal snang brtan po ma byung bar du bsgom/ 'bru re re bzhin klog pa'i tshul du dang rang sgra di ri ri sgrogs pa rnams la sems brtan pa na sngags phreng g.yas skor dang po dal bu/ rim gyis je myur du mgal me ltar 'khor ba las 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phros pa'i sne las phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa'i lha mo nam mkha' gang ba spros pa rnams kyis bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems rnams mchod/

de rnams kyi gsang ba gsum gyi byin rlabs thams cad sku phyag rgya gu ru drag po'i sku che phra sna tshogs pa/ gsung sngags phreng dmar po rang sgra sgrogs shing me 'od 'phro ba/ thugs rdo rje rtse lnga pa sogs phyag mtshan gyi rnam par char ltar babs te 'od zer gyi rnam par gyur nas rang la thim/ dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong pho rgyud mo rgyud rnams la 'od zer phog pas de dag gi byin rlabs nus mthu dbang dang dngos grub thams cad 'od zer kha dog sna tshogs rnam par bsdus nas thim par bsam pa bdag byin rlabs kyi dmigs pa dang*/ las sbyor gyi bzlas pa'ang*/ dang po bsnyen pa'i dus dag tu: slob dpon nyid kyi thugs sngags dang : me dbal snying po sham bur bcas: rmi ltas ma byung bar du bzla: zhes bsnyen sngags kyi mthar/ a ya ma du ru tsa sha na sa ma ya hūm̐ phaṭa: badz+ra hūm̐: yak+ṣa hūm̐: rak+ṣa hūm̐: rā tsa gnod byed kyi snying la mā ra ya phaṭa/ ces btags pa dmigs gnad dang ldan pas bzla bar gsungs te grangs rtags kyi nus pa brtan nges byung ba la dgongs kyi/ gzhan du rtsa ba'i bzlas pa'i mjug tu mtshon byed tsam bzlas pas chog go /thun 'jog pa na dbyangs gsal dang yig brgya rten snying lan gsum gsum gyis sku gsung thugs kyi lhag chad kha bskang zhing nus pa brtan par bya/ bzlas pa stong stong re'i mtshams su stong tshigs kyi mchod bstod 'byung ba rig 'dzin gong ma'i phyag len gyi rgyun ltar nus na legs/ thun mtshams su gtor ma 'bul ba ni/ mchod rdzas sman rag gtor gsum la dmigs te/ rang gi snying ga nas ram̐ yam̐ kham̐ sogs nas/ ha ho hrīḥ'i bar gong rjes gnang gi skabs ltar brjod pas byin gyis brlabs nas/ mdun gyi nam mkhar pam̐ pad+ma maṇ+ḍa la hūm̐/ sna tshogs pad+ma'i gdan/ ma sūr+ya maṇ+ḍa la hūm̐/ nyi ma'i gdan/ a tsan+d+ra maṇ+ḍa la hūm̐/ zla ba'i gdan/ tir bam̐ maṇ+ḍa la hūm̐/ dregs pa pho mo'i gdan rnams brtsegs mar gsal bar gyur/

ces gdan bskyed/ rang gi thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas lho nub rnga yab gling phran pad+ma 'od kyi gzhal yas nas slob dpon chen po pad+ma thod phreng rtsal drag po'i lha tshogs dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyis bskor ba oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes dang*/ hūm̐/ dur khrod smug nag me 'bar klong dkyil nas// dregs pa 'dul mdzad pad+ma thod phreng rtsal// bzhengs shig bzhengs shig chos kyi dbyings nas bzhengs// dug lnga rang sar dag pa'i klong nas bzhengs// dgra bgegs dam sri 'dul phyir gshegs su gsol// ma hā gu ru pad+ma kro dha sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes spyan drangs/ hūm̐/ bskal pa me ltar 'bar ba'i klong dkyil nas// ti ra zhing chen bsnol ba'i gdan steng du// ma hā gu ru pad+ma thod phreng rtsal// 'khor bcas dgyes shing brtan par bzhugs su gsol// ma hā gu ru pad+ma kro dha sa pa ri wā ra sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan/ zhes bzhugs su gsol/ hūm̐/ rang byung pad+ma thod phreng drag po'i sku// dregs pa lha srin ste brgyad 'dul mdzad cing*// 'khor ba ma lus 'dren pa'i dpal gyur pa// gu ru drag po'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo// ma hā gu ru pad+ma kro dha sa pa ri wā ra pā da bhan+dha naṃ ka ro mi/ zhes phyag 'tshal nas/ ma hā gu ru pad+ma kro dha sa pa ri wā ra oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ/ pā d+yaṃ/ puṣ+pe/ dhū pe/ ā lo ke/ gan+dhe/ nai wi d+yā/ shab+da pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ ma hā pañtsa a mṛ ta khā hi/ ma hā rak+ta khā hi/ lha tshogs rnams kyi ljags 'od zer gyi sbu gus bdud rtsi'i bcud drangs te dgyes pa chen pos rkan sgra dang bcas te bzhes par bsams la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ artsig nirtsig na mo bha ga wa te hūm̐ hūm̐ a hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ya mān+ta ka ha ya grī ba badz+ra pā ṇi/ ḍā ki nī ga ru ḍa hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣa hūm̐ phaṭa/ i daṃ ba liṃ gṛh+ṇa khā hi/ dgra bgegs thams cad kyi gti mug sha la khā hi/

zhe sdang rus la khā hi/ 'od chags khrag la khā hi/ dbang po lnga la khā hi/ lan bdun nam gsum/ hūm̐/ pad+ma drag po bka' yi 'khor dang bcas// dug gsum sha khrag mchod pa 'di bzhes la// byang chub sgrub la bar du gcod pa yi// dgra bgegs thams cad rdul du brlag pa dang*// rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa la// tshe 'di'i gnod pa thams cad zhi nas kyang*// phyi ma byang chub go 'phang thob par mdzod// ces phrin las bcol/ bstod pa ni/ hūm̐/ khams gsum gnas na stobs ldan rdzu 'phrul can// nub phyogs bde ba can gyi zhing khams nas// snang ba mtha' yas sku gsung thugs las sprul// ngo mtshar rmad byung badz+ra he ru ka /mthu chen pad+ma dbang phyug rdzu 'phrul can// ya mān+ta ka rta mgrin dbang gi rgyal// gsang ba'i bdag po ye shes mkha' 'gro lnga// bya khyung mthing nag yak+ṣa me dbal te// dbang drag pad+ma'i lha la phyag 'tshal bstod// ces bstod/ de nas ma mgon sde brgyad la mchod gtor 'bul ba ni/ gtor ma ram̐ yam̐ kham̐ gis sbyang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis byin gyis brlab/ rang nyid pad+ma drag por gsal ba'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas ma mgon lcam dral sde brgyad 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa ma dzaḥ hūm̐/ spros bral chos dbyings 'og min dag pa che// ma 'gags rol pa lhun grub dur khrod nas// rang rig rtsal grub dam ldan dregs byed tshogs// rnal 'byor sgrub pa'i gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol// oṃ badz+ra ma hā kā la/ oṃ badz+ra re ma ti/ a ya ma du ru tsa sha na dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan/ a ti pū hoḥ pra tīts+tsha ho: oṃ badz+ra ma hā kā la/ oṃ badz+ra re ma ti/ a ya ma du ru tsa sha na/ ma hā pañtsa rak+ta ba liṃ ta khā hi/ ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ bstod pa ni/ gdod nas 'gyur med lhun grub kun tu bzang*// sna tshogs sgyu 'phrul rdo rje'i gar mdzad gtso// dpal ldan ye shes mgon po nag po che// yum mchog lha mo dregs pa'i tshogs bcas la// bstod do khas blangs dam las ma g.yel bar// las bzhi'i phrin las lhun gyi sgrub par mdzod/

badz+ra muḥde nas tshogs mchod 'bul ba la'ang bdun gyi thog mar yo byad rnams la/ oṃ sarba dra byaṃ bi sho dha ni hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces bsang gtor bya/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐/ rang gi thugs ka'i hūm̐ las ram̐ yam̐ kham̐ 'phros pas ma dag pa'i dngos 'dzin thams cad bsregs gtor bkrus te stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las tshogs gzhong pad+ma 'bar bar tshogs rdzas rigs lnga yab yum gyi dam tshig chen po'i rang bzhin 'dod yon gyi rnam pa ci yang 'char bar gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlab/ gnyis pa spyan drang ba ni/ hūm̐/ pad+ma 'od kyi gzhal yas nas// bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro'i tshogs// longs spyod tshogs kyi 'khor lo la// spyan drangs mchod kyis gshegs su gsol// gu ru de ba ḍā ki ni sa ma ya dzaḥdzaḥ gsum pa dang po tshogs phud 'bul ba ni/ hūm̐/ bde bar gshegs so bcom ldan 'das// sangs rgyas kun gyi bdag nyid che// bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro'i tshogs// zhal zas tshogs kyi mchod pa bzhes// oṃ āḥhūm̐ gu ru de ba ḍā ki nī ga ṇa tsakra pū dza khā hi/ bzhi pa bar pa bshags pa ni/ hūm̐/ sngon byung dus nas da lta'i bar// ma rig dbang gis lus ngag sems// bag med dam las 'gal gyur na// 'dod yon tshogs kyi mchod pas bshags// badz+ra sa ma ya ho: yig brgya bzlas/ lnga pa tha ma bsgral stabs ni/ nṛ tri badz+ra aṃ ku sha ya dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ hūm̐/ che mchog pad+ma thod phreng rtsal// sku mdog dmar po me ltar 'bar// phyag g.yas rdo rje rtse lnga gdengs// g.yon pas phur bus dgra snying gzir// khyed kyi thugs dam dus la bab// sdang ba'i dgra dang gnod pa'i bgegs// gang la bya ba khyod kyis shes// rdul du rlog la dbyings su sgrol// sha khrag klad pa mchod pa'i tshogs// zhal du bstab bo kha raṃ khā hi// gnod byed pho mo rdul du rlog /oṃ ma hā kro dha pad+ma kro dhī shwa rī badz+ra kī li kī la ya ma hā yak+ṣa kā la rū pa karma raṃ raṃ dz+wa la raṃ/

oṃ ma hā gu ru ka pā la mā la badz+ra sa mā ya dzaḥ nṛ tri sha truṃ gnod byed dgra bgegs mā ra ya phaṭa/ bo dhi tsit+ta oṃ/ bo dhi tsit+ta āḥ bo dhi tsit+ta hūm̐/ zhes pas bsgral/ oṃ gu ru de ba ḍā ki nī sa pa ri wā ra ma hā māṃ sa khā hi/ ma hā rak+ta khā hi/ ma hā kiṃ ni ri ti khā hi/ ma hā tsit+ta khā hi/ ma hā go ro tsa na pū dza kha kha khā hi khā hi/ bhin+da ya bhin+da ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces bstab bo// drug pa tshogs la rol pa ni/ las kyi rdo rjes/ hoḥ zhal zas tshogs kyi mchod pa 'di// 'dod yon ma spangs longs spyod ldan// dngos grub sna tshogs 'di las 'byung*// tshogs kyi mchod pa rgyan du rol// zhes zhus pa la/ lan du/ a la la hoḥ zhes blangs la nang gi sreg blug dang ldan pas longs spyad/ bdun pa lhag ma gtong ba ni/ hūm̐/ las kyi rdo rje byed par dbang bskur ba// ma mo mkha' 'gro dpa' bo ging gi tshogs// lhag ma kha chu'i dam la gtogs pa rnams// thugs dam bzhin du mchod kyis gshegs su gsol// dam can ma lus pa rnams 'dir 'dus shig /sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ sarba ḍā ki nī e ā ral+li hriṃ hriṃ dzaḥdzaḥ phud lhag bsre/ byin rlabs spyi ltar byas la/ hūm̐/ dang po phud kyis mi mchod du// pad+ma 'byung gnas phud kyi bdag /bar du tshogs la mi rol tu// ma dang mkha' 'gro tshogs la rol// lhag ma kha chus mi bran du// bran pho bran mo kha chu'i bdag /phud dang lhag ma mi bsre ru// khyed dang ye nas tha tshig gcig /las rnams rim par mi bcol tu// las kyi 'du skal so sor yod// sngon gyi dam bcas khas blangs bzhin// bcol pa'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod// uts+tshiṣ+ṭa ba liṃ ta khā hi/ zhes phyi rol tu phul/ dpal mgon sogs phyi rgyud pa rnams la gong sngon 'gro'i skabs ltar dkar dmar gtor ma bsngo/ tshogs nub dang po dang*/ yar mar gyi tshes bcu'i dus las rgyun du ma lcogs kyang chog

de nas yig brgya lan gsum dang*/ mdun gyi lha rang dang dbyer med du gyur par bsam/ bsdu rim ni/ bdag gi thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas snod bcud thams cad 'od du zhu nas srung 'khor gzhal yas 'khor dang bcas pa la thim/ de gtso bo la thim/ sprul pa'i lha rnams kyang gtso bo la thim/ de thugs ka'i hūm̐ la thim/ de'ang zhabs kyu ha khog la/ de zla tshes la/ de thig le la/ de nā da la thim/ de mi dmigs pa stong par gyur par bsams la mnyam par bzhag slar rtsa sngags brjod la/ slar yang rang nyid skad cig gis gu ru drag po'i skur gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra ka ba tsi rak+ṣa haṃ/ zhes pas gnas gsum brlabs shing go bgo /snang grags rtog tshogs thams cad lha sngags ye shes kyi rol par bltas la dge ba bsngo/ spyod lam kun tu dran shes dang ma bral bas lam khyer gyi rnal 'byor rnams la brtson/ thun phyi ma rnams la sngon gtor mi dgos pas skyabs sems dang tshogs bsag nas bskyar/ thun mtshams gtor 'bul re re bzhin gal che bas mchod gtor rnams kha gsos la byin rlabs nas bzung phrin bcol gyi bar du gong smos ltar la/ de nas bstod pa bya zhing bsdu ldang la 'jug thun thams cad la rgyas pa ma lcogs na/ byin rlabs sngon du 'gro bas/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas bla ma dang gu ru drag po'i lha tshogs yi dam dpa' bo mkha' 'gro dam can srung ma'i tshogs dang bcas pa mdun gyi nam mkhar badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ gu ru de ba ḍā ki ni sa pa ri wā ra oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā sogs nas/ mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsal du gsol/ zhes bstod pa'i bar sgrub thabs kyi gtor 'bul ltar phul yang rungs/ gtor 'bul gzhan dgos tshe phyi thun gyi mjug gong 'og skabs su bab par gtong*/ ma mgon sde brgyad phyi gtor rnams dgongs mo tshar res chog dus chen rnams la tshogs mchod la bsnyen pa'i grangs tshad rdzogs pa'i skabs sham bu gzhung gsal/

gnod byed sarba mā ra ya hūm̐ phaṭa ces pa spyir btang me dbal las tshogs yin cing*/ dmigs bsal de'i mal du/ shīn+taṃ ku ru swā hā/ puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru swā hā/ ba shaṃ ku ru swā hā/ mā ra ya ku ru swā hā/ zhes pa rnams sbyar zhing phrin las bzhi sgrub pa'i 'od zer spro bsdu'i dmigs pa'ang spyi ltar sbyar/ bsnyen pa grub skabs 'jam mgon kun blo'i chog khrigs ltar phrin gzhung dregs pa zil gnon btang la tshogs mchod skong bshags srung ma'i gtor 'bul dngos grub blang ba sogs mtha' rgyas su bya/ bsnyen pa'i kha skong zhi ba'i spyin sreg gsang ba spyi ltar bsnyen pa gang 'grub kyi bcu cha bya ba sogs bsnyen sgrub kyi spyi gnad spang blang thun gyi gcod tshul rnams gzhan dang mthun no// de ltar bsnyen pa dbu tshugs nas ma rdzogs bar g.yeng ba'i dbang du skad cig kyang mi btang bar lha sgom sngags bzlas gcig dril bya ba dang*/ bla sgrub thams cad mos gus kho na'i lam yin pas dus rtag tu tshad bzung med pa'i mos gus drag pos thun bar rnams su gsol 'debs drag tu bya/ gzhan yang maṇ+ḍal phyag bskor la sogs pa ji ltar rigs pa'i chos spyod ci lcogs nyams su blang*/ bsnyen pa'i tshad ni dus rtags grangs gsum/ de la'ang deng sang rtags bsnyen thems pa ni nyung bas 'dir ma bris/ dus bsnyen ni mtshan rtags gsal ba'i me long las/ dbang po rab kyis zla ba gsum gyis 'grub// 'bring gis zla ba drug gis 'grub par 'gyur// tha mas zla ba bcu gnyis dag tu ni// nges par 'grub 'gyur o rgyan nyid kyis gsungs// zhes 'byung ba ltar dang*/ nyung mtha' zhag nyer gcig gis kyang rung bar bshad/ grangs tshad ni de nyid las/ 'bum phrag drug gis rang lus byin gyis rlob// 'bum phrag bcu yis las tshogs thams cad 'grub// bye ba gcig dang 'bum phrag gsum gyis ni// nus pa o rgyan pad+ma nyid dang mnyam// zhes dman 'bring mchog gi tshad du gsungs shing*/

'bum phrag nyi shu thems na rtsa sngags kyi 'bru 'bum du 'gyur bas shin tu legs/ drag po'i rtsa sngags 'di sangs rgyas kun gyi spyi sngags yin par gur drag rtsa ba'i rgyud sogs las phan yon bsngags pa rgya cher 'byung zhing*/ gzhung las kyang*/ khyad par gsang sngags thams cad kyi yang zab// brgya tsam bzlas pas las kyi sgrib pa spong*// stong tsam bzlas pas nyams chags thams cad skong*// khri tsam bzlas na sde brgyad dbang du 'dus// 'bum tsam bzlas na pad+ma nyid dang mjal// ces sogs bzlas sgom gyi phan yon tshad med par gsungs pa la yid ches pas nyams len snying por bya ba gces so// ༈ /las tshogs la zhi ba'i byab chog gdon dgrol ni/ gter gzhung las/ drag po bla ma'i thugs sgrub las: byab gtor nad pa gso ba ni: klu gdon can nam smyon pa yi: nad pa'i lus la zan bsgres la: chang rjes brgya dang rtsa brgyad bya: ngar mi brgya rtsa'i mdun du bzhag: sdig pa 'jigs pa'i gzugs byas la: kha dgu mig dgu mgo dgu pa: bag zan dag la bzos nas ni: rdza ma'i nang du bzhag par bya: rang nyid

o rgyan pad+ma gtso 'khor rnams/ bskyed rim gsal bar bsgom: nad 'dre gang yin bkug nas su: dngos su de nyid yod par bsam: des kyang khug par ma gyur na: lcags kyu'i phyag rgya bcas nas ni: drag sngags sham bur 'di nyid gdags: gnod byed aṃ ku sha dzaḥdzaḥ tri khug dzaḥdzaḥ zhes pa'i sham bu btags nas ni: ma khug bar du dgug gzhug bya: khug nas byab chog bya ba ni: rma bya'i mdongs cig thogs nas ni: drag sngags sham la 'di nyid gdags: oṃ phu le phu le phud phud: ha la ha la phud phud: nad gdon sdig sgrib thams cad: shīn+taṃ ku ru phud phud: puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru phud phud: ba shaṃ ku ru phud phud: mā ra ya phud phud swā hā: zla ba'i dkyil 'khor hūm̐ gis mtshan: rma bya'i mdongs dang dbyer med bsam: nad pa'i lus la byab pa yis: nad kyi rnam pa thams cad dang : sa bdag klu nad 'ja' lta bur: thon nas glud la thim par bsam: ngar glud re la bdun bdun byab: de ltar brgya dang rtsa brgyad bya: ngar glud gang gnod sa ru bskyal: de lta bu yi sbyor ba yis: lha chen tshangs pa'i nad yin kyang : bud par 'gyur ba the tshom med: klu dang sa bdag smros ci dgos: bdag 'dra bud med blo dman yang : bla ma'i thugs sgrub drag sngags las: byab gtor gnod byed gdon sel bkod: phyi rabs las can gcig dang sprod: ces gsungs pas 'di'i bsnyen pa las rung gang zag gis gzhan gyi nad gdon bsal bar 'dod na/ rdza dmar po'am/ zangs snod gru gsum nang du bag zan las sdig pa mgo dgu/ mig dgu/ kha dgu pa byas la gzhug ste dngos su bsam/ nad pa'i lus la gril ba'i zan ngar chung brgya rtsa brgyad dang*/ changs bu brgya rtsa brgyad byas te snod gcig tu bzhag mchod pa byin rlabs nas dngos grub gsol ba'i bar bdag mdun dbyer med kyi bskyed bzlas rjes gnang skabs ltar grub nas/ nad pa'i mdun du stegs kyi khar theb tse lnga tshar ram bdun bsgrigs pa'i nang du ngar mi re dang changs bu re dgod/

chu gtsang dang*/ ku sha rma bya'i mdongs can 'du bya/ rang dang nad pa'i logs drung gang bder sdig gzugs de bzhag la 'di skad brjod/ 'o na da lam khyod rang la bcom ldan 'das gu ru drag po'i sgo nas byab chog gdon dgrol chen mo byed pa yin pas/ slob dpon rang nyid skad cig gis gu ru drag po sku mdog dmar po me'i phreng bas brgyan pa/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ spyan gsum bgrad pa/ phyag g.yas pas gnam lcags kyi rdo rje rtse dgu pa nam mkha' la 'phyar ba/ g.yon pas lcags kyi sdig pa mgo dgu pa bsnams pa/ dbu skra snum 'bol gyen la brdzes pa/ thod pa skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/ rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ sku la rus pa'i rgyan drug dang sbrul gyis brgyan pa/ sku stod la glang lpags dang zhing chen gyi g.yang gzhi'i na bza' gsol ba/ sku smad la stag gi pags pa'i 'og pag can/ khrag gi thig le dang*/ zhag gi zo ris dang*/ thal chen gyi tshom bus brgyan pa/ zhabs 'dor stabs kyis me phung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'i sku can du gsal bas khyed rang gi nad thams cad byab pa dang*/ gdon dgrol ba'i cho ga mngon du mdzad pa'i mos pa mdzod/ de ltar rang nyid gu ru drag dmar me phreng can du gsal ba'i thugs ka nas sprul pa'i khro bo yak+ṣa me dbal grangs med nam mkha' khyab par 'phros pas/ nad pa 'di la gnod cing 'tshe'i nad gdon gang yin pa de'i rke nas zhags pas bzung ste/ rang dbang med par bkug nas sdig pa'i gzugs dang dbyer med par gyur/ lcags kyu'i phyag rgya bcas te/ na mo byin rlabs kyi rtsa ba dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ dngos grub kyi rtsa ba yi dam lha tshogs rnams kyi= phrin las kyi rtsa ba chos skyong srung ma rnams kyi= bdag nyid gu ru drag po pad+ma thod phreng rtsal gyi lha tshogs rnams kyi= 'jam dpal sku'i lha tshogs rnams kyi= rta mgrin gsung gi lha tshogs rnams kyi=

phyag rdor thugs kyi lha tshogs rnams kyi= ḍā ki yon tan kyi lha tshogs rnams kyi= me dbal phrin las kyi lha tshogs rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ stobs ldan sdig pa nag po'i bden pa dang*/ pho nya za byed gsod byed bstan srung dam can rgya mtsho'i lha tshogs rnams kyi bden pa dang*/ bden pa chen po'i mthus bsrung bya nad pa che ge mo zhes bgyi ba 'di la dang po nad kyi sna 'dren pa/ bar du nad kyi tshang bca' ba/ tha ma nad la mi phan par byed pa'i gnod byed gdon bgegs sa bdag klu gnyan gang yin pa thams cad skad cig rang dbang med par 'dir khug cig oṃ āḥhūm̐ artsika nirtsika na mo bha ga wa te hūm̐ hūm̐ āḥhūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa: badz+ra hūm̐: yak+ṣa hūm̐: rak+ṣa hūm̐: a ya ma du ru tsa sha na gnod byed aṃ ku sha dzaḥdzaḥ tri khu dzaḥdzaḥ zhes lan gsum dang des ma khugs na slar yang lcags kyu'i rgya dang song ma thag pa'i sngags gsham can brjod de khugs sems ma byung bar dgug gzhug bya/ khug pa dang*/ 'o/ de ltar bkug pas rang gi mdun du dngos su khug nas gnod byed kyi gdug pa thams cad zhi nas gus shing 'dud pa dang bka' nyan gsung sdod pa la ngar glud bdud rtsi 'dod pa'i yon tan sna tshogs su gyur pa lan chags 'jal ba'i phyir du byin pas lan chags byang*/ bu lon sod nas dga' mgu yi rang dang ldan par gyur/ theb tse'i glud rnams chab kyis bran la/ oṃ sarba dra byaṃ sho dha ni hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ swa bhā wa sogs/ stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las bh+rūm̐ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du oṃ āḥhūm̐ 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i lan chags kyi changs bu 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga dang ldan pa/ theb kyu bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho/ ngar mi glud gzugs phung khams skye mched yongs su rdzogs pa mi pho dang mi mo rnams su gyur/ oṃ a kā ro sogs kyis byin brlabs nas/ g.yon dril bu 'khrol/

g.yas pas theb tse'i nang gi glud changs ngar mi re bzung nas nad pa'i lus la g.yas skor gsum re'am re re dang*/ g.yon skor kyang de ltar bya zhing*/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yo bi shwa mu khe bh+yaḥ sarba thā khaṃ ud+ga te s+pha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ swā hā/ tshar gsum mam re re brjod cing gdon des zos 'thungs tshim par bsams la sdig pa'i rdza ma de'i nang du blug de nas lag g.yas rdo rje'i phyag rgya dang bcas pas ku sha rma bya'i mdongs can thogs nas/ da nged kyi lag na ku sha la rma bya'i mdongs dang dbyer med pa'i zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ yig dkar pos mtshan par gsal bas khyed rang gi lus byabs pas nad gdon sdig sgrib thams cad 'ja' tshon lta bu'i rnam pas sngo dmar khra khrug khrug khyed rang gi lus las thon nas ngar glud kyi khrod du song bar gyur par mos shig ces sdig gzugs dang der dor ba'i ngar glud de'i steng du lan bdun re byab tshul bya zhing*/ gong gi drag sngags gsham du oṃ phu le phu le phud phud: ha la ha la phud phud: nad gdon sdig sgrib thams cad shān+tiṃ ku ru phud phud: puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru phud phud: ba shaṃ ku ru phud phud: mā ra ya ku ru phud phud swā hā: zhes theb tse re re bzhin sngags tshar re brjod/ theb tse lnga bdun gang yod rdzogs nas slar sngar ltar bsham zhing glud gtor byin brlab man chad bskyar/ de ltar brgya rtsa brgyad rdzogs pa dang ngar glud gang gnod pa'i phyogs su bskyal/ slob dpon gyis drag sngags dang sum+bha ni brjod cing nad pa la thun gyis brdeg srung 'khor bsgom/ rgyal ba sras bcas bden pa'i byin rlabs dang*// bcom ldan dbang drag pad+ma'i bden pa'i mthus// 'gro ba 'di la bdag gis bsrungs zin gyi// 'di la sus kyang gnod pa ma byed cig /artsika mjug tu mā ra ya rak+ṣa bh+rūm̐/ bgegs rigs stong phrag brgyad cu zhi ba dang*// sogs dang*/

sems can nad pa ji snyed pa// sogs kyis smon lam bya'o// ༈ /drag po'i byab chog gdon dgrol ni/ gter gzhung las/ drag po bla ma'i thugs sgrub las: gong gi byab gtor gso thabs dang : de gong mdze nad gso ba yis: nad pa sos par ma gyur na: drag po'i mtha' 'dul 'di ltar bya: bdag nyid ting 'dzin gsal bar bskyed: rdza bag zan nam/ so btang ba'i sdig pa gcig: kha dgu shin tu gdangs pa la: mig dgu 'jigs pa'i gzugs can bya : yak+ṣa me dbal sprul pa gcig: rang bzhin gnas nas bkug la bstim: rdza'am zangs dmar nang du bcug: zangs dmar gru gsum 'bar bar bskyed: me dbal dbyer med sdig pa ni: ri rab tsam du che bar bsam: kha dgu shin tu gdangs par bskyed: changs rjes dri dang ngar mi re: nad pa'i lus la byabs byas la: byabs pa nad 'dre dngos su bsam: drag sngags sham la 'di nyid gdags: na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta a wa lo ki te: oṃ sam+bha ra sam+bha ra hūm̐: de yi zhabs su 'di yang btags: na ra yan bha gha bha dhe pu ra ho: drag po sdig pa'i gzugs can khyod: gnod byed 'byung po'i sha khrag la khā hi khā hi: zhes pa'i drag sngags brjod pa yis: rgyal bsen sa bdag ma lus pa: sdig pas lcib lcib zos par bsam: chu dang changs rjes ngar mi re: drag sngags tshar re yis 'bul bar bya/ zer ba 'dug sham bu btags la/ sngags brgya rtsa re res 'bul: thon nas phrin las drag tu bya: gzugs 'gros changs rjes rdza dang bcas: mtsho 'am rgya ram lam phrag tu: gru gsum khru gang dong brus la: de nyid du ni mnan par bya: ye shes sdig pa dbyings su gshegs: steng du bla ma'i gtor ma blug: de ltar byas pa'i sbyor ba yis: ye shes lha yi gnod pa yang : skad cig nyid la zhi gyur na: lha srin sde brgyad smros ci dgos: gzhan la mi spel gter du rgya: dus la ma bab gtam pa'i rgya: byang chub sems ldan gtad pa'i rgya: skal ba can la spel ba'i rgyaḥ

dam med rnams la gsang ba'i rgya: rgya lngas btab pa'i drag sgrub skor: snyigs ma phyi rabs don du ni: sems can rnams la phan thogs shog: ces pas gal te zhi chog gis ma phan na/ rdza dmar po so btang ba'am zangs snod gru gsum pa'i nang du kham sa las byas pa'i sdig pa nag po mgo dgu rwa bco brgyad pa/ kha dgu gdangs pa/ mig dgu bsgrad pa 'jigs pa'i gzugs can zhig byas la gzhag nad pa'i lus la gril ba'i ngar mi brgya rtsa brgyad/ changs bu brgya rtsa brgyad byas te snod gcig tu gzhag de nas bdag bskyed bzlas tshar nas/ rang dang nad pa'i bar du theb tser ngar changs re sngar ltar bsgrig mdun du sdig gzugs gzhag rdzas dgod/ gu gul rdo thun bcas 'du byas nas/ 'o na kha sang zhi ba'i byab chog byas kyang khyed rang nad stobs che ba dang gdon bying che drags pas drag bskyed ma byung 'dug par/ da ni drag po'i byab chog gdon dgrol zhes bya ba de byed pa yin pas/ slob dpon rang nyid skad cig gis gu ru drag po nas/ dbus na bzhugs pa'i sku can zhig gi bar zhi ba'i skabs ltar la/ khyed rang la drag po'i gdon 'grol dngos su mdzad pa'i mos pa mdzod/ sdig pa bran la/ oṃ sarba dra byaṃ sho dha ni hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ swa bhā wa sogs/ stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las snod mi dmigs par e las lcags bsregs 'bar ba'i khang sgrom gru gsum pa bskal pa'i me 'bar ba stong gsum dang mnyam pa'i nang du/ sdig pa'i gzugs mi dmigs pa las hūm̐ mthing nag de las 'od zer 'phros pas sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad mchod/ thugs dam gyi rgyud bskul/ gnod byed gdon bgegs thams cad tshar bcad/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las lcags kyi sdig pa nag po mgo dgu rwa bco brgyad pa/ kha dgu gdangs pa/ mig dgu bsgrad pa/ lus po dmar nag gnyer mas gang ba/ rwa g.yas pas srid pa'i rtse mo bsnyil ba/ rwa g.yon pas sa 'og steng nas g.yeng ba/

yan lag bsgrengs pas sa gzhi khengs pa/ lus ri rab tsam la rdo rje'i me'i tshwa tshwa 'phro ba/ 'jigs su rung ba/ gnod byed thams cad rwa yis bzung nas kha dgu shin tu gdangs pa hab hab za ba/ me dpung rab tu 'bar ba'i nang na gnas pa'i snying gar hūm̐ mthing nag gis mtshan par gyur/ bdag gi thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas 'og min dang lcang lo can nas khro bo yak+ṣa me dbal gyi thugs ka nas bsgoms pa dang 'dra ba'i sprul pa'i sdig pa zhig spyan drangs/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra tsit+ta dung dung ru ru bha sha hūm̐ phaṭa: e h+ye hi badz+ra sa ma ya dzaḥdzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho: zhes pa'i sngags dang dmigs pas lan bdun spyan drangs la bstim/ theb tse'i ngar glud du chu thigs re blugs shing*/ lcags kyu'i phyag rgyas/ na mo/ byin rlabs kyi rtsa ba dpal ldan bla ma sogs nas/ mi phan par byed pa'i bar zhi ba'i skabs ltar la/ gnod byed gdon bgegs sa bdag klu gnyan rgyal bsen dam sri thams cad glud gzugs ngar mi 'di la khug cig oṃ āḥhūm̐ artsig nas/ tri khug dzaḥdzaḥbar gong ltar dang*/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes pas zhi chog ltar dgug de nged kyi lag gi ku sha la rma bya'i mdongs dang nas/ ngar glud kyi khrod du song bar bsam bar dang*/ drag sngags gsham du oṃ phu le nas mā ra ya ku ru phud phud swā hā'i bar zhi chog ltar dang byab tshul lan bdun bya/ oṃ sarba dra byaṃ sho dha ni hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ swa bhā wa sogs/ stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las bh+rūm̐ las rin po che'i snod du ngo bo nad gdon la rnam pa bdud rtsi 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga dang ldan par gyur/ oṃ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta a wa lo ki te oṃ sam+bha ra sam+bha ra hūm̐ zhes lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlob/ dgug gzhug dang*/ byab pa/ byin rlabs rnams theb tse lnga'am bdun gang yod la dus gcig tu byas la/ khyed rang gi nad gdon thams cad sngon dmar du long long*/

'dar had had lus las mngon sum du thon te/ mdun du sprul pa'i sdig rgod yak+ṣa me dbal dang dbyer med pa ri rab tsam du che ba des rwas bzung ste kha dgu shin tu gdangs pas hab hab ljib ljib zos par mos shig ces dang*/ g.yon dril bu gsil zhing*/ g.yas pas theb tse'i ngar changs nad pa'i lus la g.yon du bskor zhing*/ gong gi drag sngags mjug tu a wa lo ki te sam+bha ra sam+bha ra: na ra yan bha gha bha te phu ra hoḥ drag po sdig pa'i gzugs can gyis gnod byed 'byung po'i sha khrag la khā hi khā hi: zhes btags pa brjod de sdig pa'i snod du dor/ de ltar snga ma bshams pa rdzogs nas/ slar yang ngar changs dang*/ chu thigs re blugs nas dgug gzhug man chad bskyar te brgya rtsa brgyad rdzogs pa dang*/ phrin las drag tu bskul ba ni/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas mthu stobs mkhyen brtse yis: 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal 'di la ma gzigs sam: phan bde mdzad pa'i sems bskyed bor nus sam: dus gsum phyogs bcu'i bde gshegs dbyings nas bzhengs: hūm̐ hūm̐: khyad par pad+ma drag rtsal rab khros pa'i: yak+ṣa me dbal thugs rje gnad nas bskul: rgyal ba'i mdzad pa phrin las nus mthu'i rtsal: rngam brjid gdon bgegs log 'dren zas su zo: hūm̐ hūm̐: sangs rgyas rnams kyis dbang bskur mthu byin pa'i: yak+ṣa me dbal gnam lcags sdig pa'i sku: drag rtsal gzi 'bar drag sngags thog ser 'phro: gdon bgegs skad cig ma bzhag myur du zo: zhes ting nge 'dzin ma yengs pas bskul zhing rdzas rgod dang gu gul bdug thun gyis brabs te artsika sham bu can dang*/ khyung sngags/ sum+bha ni sogs dang*/ oṃ badz+ra dzñā na rā tsa tsit+ta srog dung dung*/ ru ru bha sha hūm̐ phaṭa/ ma ma srog dung dung*/ snying laṃ laṃ/ ma ma bh+yo/ trig sho trig sho rā tsa thuṃ thuṃ ling gnod byed hur thuṃ ling*/ gnod byed khug thuṃ ling*/ gnod byed khug rā tsa ling*/

tri tsa pa la a shug me baṃ laṃ shan tri dza se dun dun dzaḥhūm̐ phaṭa/ ces tshar gsum sogs gang 'grub brjod/ de nas/ sdig pa'i ye shes pa yak+ṣa me dbal rang bzhin chos kyi dbyings su gshegs su gsol/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra tsit+ta dung dung ru ru bha sha hūm̐ phaṭa: badz+ra mu: zhes brjod nas rdza sdig glud changs dang bcas mtsho'i nang du sba ba'am/ yang na chu bo chen po'i gzhung du bskyur te phyi mig mi blta bar log go /yang nad gdon gyi rjes gcod byed na rnal 'byor pa rang nyid song la lam rgya gram zhig tu dkar gtor gser skyems bsngo/ grub na lto 'phye brtsis nas sa brko ste dong khru gang gru gsum brus par dang por glud gtor thams cad blugs la gnod byed dgug gzhug lan gsum bya/ de steng sdig gzugs kyis mnan/ sa rim pa dgu dang rgya gram re bris la/ oṃ lam̐ hūm̐ lam̐ staṃ bha ya nan zhes bro brdung*/ de'i steng du bla ma'i gtor ma blug go /'di cung gnyan pas nus pa thon pa dang bskyed rim brten pa gal che'o// de ltar 'di dag gi dngos gzhi grub nas rjes kyi rim pa rnams bsngo smon bkra shis kyis mtha' brgyan te bya'o// zhes pa'ang gter ston grub thob thams cad kyi rgyal po gu ru nyang nyi ma 'od zer gyi gter gzhung gi dgongs pa la rata gling lugs kyi chags med chog khrigs la gzhi byas te blo gter dbang pos bris pa dge legs 'phel// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten rin po che bya rung kha shor gyi nye 'gram rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa glog klad dpar khang las/ bder gshegs 7skyabs rje bco brgyad khri chen rdo rje 'chang mchog gi thugs dgongs rdzogs ched/ skyabs 'og pa tshar grwa gu rus glog klad phyag deb ched 'grem spel zhus pa'i dge 'bras sangs rgyas zhing du bsngo'o// //
